item.title: Festival Tours
item.description: Festival tours showcasing Bhutanese Tshechus ……“That’s why UD Travels is Best for You”……… Festival Tourism Unique Divine Travels focuses festival tour on Tshechu (sacred performing arts) that is held depending on the auspicious day of Bhutanese Lunar Calendar. Among several Tshechus in Bhutan, our special festival tour is Jampa Lhakhang Tshechu which carries paramount sacred values and showcases cultural integrity, arts and crafts. March to April and September through December
